Set the panel title to exactly '{{runid}} Availability'. Leave the query as the default testdata query. Click Apply/Back to exit the panel editor, then explicitly SAVE the dashboard (Ctrl+S or the Save button) and confirm the save dialog so it persists. Report the panel title shown on the dashboard, the data source used by the panel, and whether the save succeeded.
